verdicts.quote: the erg and upper-body work are still fair game, so keep those going while it settles
verdicts.why: Gives training advice about a reported ankle injury, which the guidebook prohibits.
No weight, body shape, or earning/burning language; avoid_weight_talk is false.
Starts and ends with names, is specific to the week, and has no guilt or hype.
Workout days, durations, and sleep figure match the data; the ankle report is acknowledged.
